scenicChapters.title: Jura Crest Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 70 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-hautecombe-le-grand-lac-de-clairv.story: From Aix-les-Bains it runs 290 km to Aix-les-Bains; allow about 5 h of riding. The stops in between: Immeuble Clarté, Le Grand Lac de Clairvaux and back through Immeuble Clarté. It crosses from France into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
